content:
The image shows a leaf with multiple circular lesions featuring:
- Dark brown borders with tan/gray centers
- Small dark specks (pycnidia) visible within lesion centers
- Multiple discrete spots scattered across the leaf surface
- No concentric rings (distinguishing it from early blight)

This is a textbook presentation of Septoria leaf spot, matching the class `Septoria_Leaf_Blotch` — "Circular, tan to gray lesions... Small dark spots (pycnidia) in lesion centers where spores are produced; dark-brown perimeter with possible yellow halo; lesions are smaller than early blight and lack concentric rings."
